in_sanskrit.name: विरेंद्रसिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विर (vira) - valiant, रेंद्र (rendra) - Lord, सिंह (singha) - Lion. Thus, Virendrasinh means 'Lord of the Valiant Lion'.

in_hindi.name: विरेंद्रसिंह
in_hindi.meaning: शूरवेер (shoorveer) - Valiant, राजा (rajaa) - King, सिंह (singha) - Lion. Thus, Virendrasinh means 'Valiant King Lion' in Hindi.

in_marathi.name: Virendrasinh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Virendrasinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Virendrasinh is composed of two words: 'Virendra' and 'Sinh'. 'Virendra' means 'brave' or 'lord' in Sanskrit. 'Sinh' means 'lion' in Sanskrit. Therefore, the name Virendrasinh translates to 'Brave Lion' or 'Brave Lord'.
